definitions.ask: Should the agent panel's raw-prompt header highlight placeholders too, not just the stash previews?

choices.label: All highlight_prompt_text views, including the agent raw-prompt header, highlight placeholders
Only stash, trash, and pinned-stash previews opt in via a flag; agent header stays unchanged

definitions.why: The raw agent prompt is the same authored text; one renderer keeps every view matching the editor
